primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;
But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.
that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: saints who are at Jerusalem と明記。

wikipediaRead.title: エルサレム
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: 日本語Wikipedia「エルサレム」記事を読んだ。現代都市としての同定は明確だが、記事は現代行政・政治状況に言及する。本文は場所の同定だけに用い、政治的帰属を本文へ転記しない。

geographicAssessmentJa: 同一IDの既存Acts候補は現代都市と位置が連続する概略候補としてのみ維持。プロフィール座標は未設定で、古代市域・政治的境界を意味しない。
sourceReuseJa: Actsの既存地図候補は同一ID/同一地物の場合に限り地図方針で候補表示を維持する。プロフィール座標には転記していない。

adjacentContextChecks.previousText: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
adjacentContextChecks.text: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.
adjacentContextChecks.nextText: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.

adjacentContextChecks.previousText: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,
adjacentContextChecks.text: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,
adjacentContextChecks.nextText: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
